record.original_question: The Bieberbach conjecture Is it true that |an | ≤ n for f in S with equality only for f (z) ≡ fθ (z)? The result is known to be true for n = 2 (see Bieberbach [97]), n = 3 (see Löwner [533]), and n = 4 (see Garabedian and Schiffer [289], Charzynski and Schiffer [153]).

evidence.quote: The Bieberbach conjecture Is it true that |an | ≤ n for f in S with equality only for f (z) ≡ fθ (z)?
De Branges’ [186] proof of the Bieberbach conjecture has transformed this field. Suppose that S is the class of functions ∞ X f (z) = z + an z n n=2 univalent in D.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ denote the class of holomorphic functions
$$f(z) = z + \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} a_n z^n$$
that are univalent (i.e., injective and analytic) on the open unit disk $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$. For each real $\theta$, define the rotated Koebe function
$$f_\theta(z) = \frac{z}{(1 - e^{i\theta} z)^2} = z + \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} n\, e^{i(n-1)\theta} z^n.$$
Prove or disprove: for every $f \in S$ and every integer $n \geq 2$,
$$|a_n| \leq n,$$
with equality for some $n \geq 2$ if and only if $f \equiv f_\theta$ for some $\theta \in \mathbb{R}$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is the classical Bieberbach conjecture, proved in full by Louis de Branges in 1985. The inequality $|a_n| \le n$ for all $n \ge 2$ holds for every $f \in S$, with equality (for any single $n$) only for the rotated Koebe functions.

status_evidence.claim: The Bieberbach conjecture was proved by de Branges in 1985.
